summary: Keep a threat seal active at all times, Judgement on cooldown, Holy Shield up for block mitigation and threat, and Consecration rolling as the AoE/multi-target backbone. Avenger's Shield opens pulls. Threat is seal + Judgement + Holy Shield + Consecration + melee.
_dev_note: Wrong-expansion guard (do NOT surface to users): Hammer of the Righteous and Divine Storm are WotLK abilities; if they appear the log is mislabeled. Keep them in off_rotation for detection but the user-facing notes stay terse.

Hammer of the Righteous.note: not a TBC ability - log may be mislabeled

Divine Storm.note: not a TBC ability - log may be mislabeled

Crusader Strike.note: Retribution ability - wrong spec for a tank

Seal of Command.note: Retribution seal - a tank should run Seal of Righteousness/Vengeance for threat

Seal of Blood.note: Retribution seal - wrong spec for a tank

Holy Light.note: heavy healing on a tank parse - wrong spec or an emergency

Holy Shock.note: Holy spec ability - wrong spec for a tank

breakpoint.note: Holy Shield should be one of the highest cast counts and held at near-full uptime - it's both the block wall and a major threat source, so gaps are the biggest mitigation and threat loss (usually mana-starvation or a missed refresh). Judgement on cooldown, Consecration rolling for sustained AoE threat, and the active seal at near-constant uptime via melee.

advisory: Blessing of Sanctuary should be active. Avenger's Shield is a pull / ranged-threat opener (longish cooldown), not a filler. A tank casting Divine Shield (bubble) mid-fight drops all aggro - heavy mid-pull use is a red flag. Mana budget caps how much Holy Shield + Consecration you can sustain, so prioritize Holy Shield uptime. Fight notes: this is the premier add/multi-target tank - on add-heavy fights (Hyjal trash, Mount, Karathress adds) lead with Consecration + Avenger's Shield and tab-Consecrate; on single-target tank-and-spank, Holy Shield + Judgement + seal melee carry the threat.
